Page.name: page
Page.description: Zero-based page index. The default ordering is defined by each collection operation.

PageSize.name: pageSize
PageSize.description: Requested page size. An owner may impose a lower maximum but must document it on the operation.

MobileSearchQuery.name: query
MobileSearchQuery.description: Search text. Blank input intentionally selects random examples.

RequestId.description: Safe request identifier for support and trace correlation.

BadRequestProblem.description: The request is malformed or violates the operation contract.

ForbiddenProblem.description: The authenticated principal is not allowed to perform the operation.

NotFoundProblem.description: The requested resource does not exist or is not visible to the principal.

ConflictProblem.description: The request conflicts with the current resource state.

PayloadTooLargeProblem.description: The request payload exceeds the accepted operation limit.

InternalServerErrorProblem.description: The server could not complete the request.

MobileClubDetail.description: Consumer-backed mobile club profile. Phone number, persistence state, audit timestamps, and unused postal code are intentionally absent.

UpdateMobileClubRequest.description: Mobile club edit command. Omitted or null name preserves the stored value. removeLogo false keeps or replaces the logo according to image presence; true removes it and forbids an image.

MobileTeamDetail.description: Team profile projection separated from downstream team, club, competition, and pool transports.

pools.description: Current competition projection order; no stable pool order is promised in this compatibility slice.

UpdateMobileTeamRequest.description: Mobile team edit command. Omitted or null display fields preserve stored values. removeLogo makes keep, replace, and remove intent explicit.

MobileTeamUpdated.description: Narrow result returned to the mobile edit workflow before its explicit refetch.

MobilePoolDetail.description: Pool profile projection separated from downstream pool, division, competition, team, and club transports.

UpdateMobilePoolRequest.description: Mobile pool edit command. Omitted or null display fields preserve stored values.

MobilePoolUpdated.description: Narrow result returned to the mobile edit workflow before its explicit refetch.

MobileAppStatus.description: Expo-facing application status without persistence identity.

UpdateMobileAppStatusRequest.description: Partial mobile administration command. Omitted and null properties both preserve the stored value.

MobileDivisionListResponse.description: Bounded active division catalog in current downstream order.

UpdateMobileDivisionRequest.description: Partial division update. Omitted and null values preserve downstream state.

UpdateMobileLegalDocumentRequest.description: Partial legal-document update. Omitted and null values preserve stored content.

MobileNotificationPageResponse.description: Stable zero-based Expo inbox page. Handwritten hooks may derive legacy next-page state from pageInfo.

RegisterMobilePushTokenRequest.description: Mobile push-registration command without Expo provider delivery models.

CreateMobileReportRequest.description: Blockout-owned mobile report and diagnostic context.

UpdateMobileUserRequest.description: Profile mutation carried by the multipart data part. removePicture makes image intent explicit.

MobileUser.description: Expo session and profile projection. The local UUID is canonical; Auth0 remains a compatibility identity input.

NumericIdentifier.description: Canonical positive numeric identifier wire shape.

EntityTypeEnum.description: Entity kinds that can be followed by a Blockout user.

GenderEnum.description: Gender category used by Blockout competition data.

ProblemDetail.description: Canonical Blockout Problem Details body. Legacy v1 error bodies remain compatibility-adapter owned.

MobileCatalogDivision.description: Division styling and label fields consumed inside mobile team, pool, card, ranking, and map workflows.

MobileTeamPool.description: Pool ranking tab embedded only in the team workflow, without pool-detail-only or compatibility fields.

MobileTeamSummary.description: Mobile team card projection. A missing division remains explicit for compatibility with current partial enrichment.

MobileRankingTeam.description: Mobile ranking and map row. Position in the containing array is authoritative. The current five-key ranking sort is preserved; exact ties retain unspecified source order because no identifier tie-breaker is introduced in this compatibility slice.

MobilePoolSummary.description: Followed-pool card projection. Missing division enrichment remains an explicit nullable result.

UtcDateTime.description: RFC 3339 timestamp normalized to UTC on Blockout-owned wires.

MobileNotification.description: Minimal Expo inbox projection enriched with an optional division logo.

PageInfo.description: Pagination metadata for zero-based Blockout collection responses. hasNext is guaranteed; totalItems is optional unless an operation explicitly guarantees an exact count.

DevicePlatformEnum.description: Platforms accepted by Blockout notification token contracts.

MobileClubSearchResult.description: Club card and navigation projection consumed by Expo search.

MobileTeamSearchResult.description: Team card, label, image, and navigation projection consumed by Expo search.

MobilePoolSearchResult.description: Pool card, label, image, and navigation projection consumed by Expo search.
